dct_description_sm:
This dashboard shows the number of assigned cases in the Manitoba Animal Welfare Program by animal type. There are 11 animal types shown. The data is summarized on a quarterly basis, beginning in 2016, to the present. The data is sorted, ascending alphabetically, by animal type, grouped into 11 different animal types. Data from this dashboard will be updated on a quarterly basis and all data comes from the Provincial Animal Welfare Program. The data table used for this dashboard is Manitoba Animal Welfare Program – Animal Types.

For more information, please refer to the Animal Welfare Main Page.
dct_title_s: Manitoba Animal Welfare Program – Animal Types Chart
